title: How to Build a Landing Page with AI (That Actually Converts)
summary: Build a landing page that captures leads and converts visitors — without writing a single line of code. Database, form backend, and hosting all included.
body_markdown:
Open[blink.new](https://blink.new/) and describe your landing page in plain text. Be specific about the audience, the offer, and the action you want visitors to take.


A good prompt: *"Build a landing page for a project management SaaS targeting freelancers. It needs a hero with a headline about saving time, three value prop bullets, a testimonials section with three dummy testimonials, and a waitlist signup form that captures name and email."*


Blink generates the full-stack app — frontend, database, backend, and hosting — from that description.
